change_summary: CFB RUN IT manual injury intake: phone-editable models/cfb/injuries/<date>.json (validated schema, sha256 receipt, archived privately), only OUT applied, roles derived from position (WR/RB/TE need starter flag), manual overrides inline intake rows, per-injury source notes, INJURY_COVERAGE_PARTIAL for teams not reviewed, workflow input injuries_path. Frozen model unchanged.
assumptions: No free programmatic CFB injury source is usable: ESPN college-football injuries endpoints return empty (count 0) for FBS teams; CFBD has no injury endpoint. Coverage is only as good as the owner's manual file.
Manual file is owner-entered and unauthenticated; reviewed_utc is self-reported.
Intakes without teams_reviewed keep legacy eligibility (no coverage check).
INJ point values in the model are untested and unchanged.

baseline.metric: Prospective untouched CFB forecast accuracy versus same-time market

evaluation.test_command: python -m unittest models.cfb.test_cfb_injury_intake models.cfb.test_cfb_run_it models.cfb.test_cfb_run_it_inputs models.cfb.test_cfb_run_it_p0
